provenance: terciles of the non-zero, eligible TRAIN window population, piece-weighted so each composition contributes the mean of its own windows; never fitted or tuned on validation or test
motif_only: rhythm and phrase thresholds are deliberately absent: Gate 3 is motif-only, and rhythm conditioning is deferred pending the codec repair (driving recall 0.292)

historical_piece_fitted.use: audits and historical comparison only, never an acceptance criterion

labelling_unit: decoded token ids of each 8-bar training window
seq_len_note: at 2048 only 1 of 50 cropped windows changes label; at 1024, 3900 windows crop and 1114 change label (29%), so labels would not describe the context the model receives
